details: The U.S. Federal Reserve increased interest rates by 25 basis points to a target range of 3.75%-4.00% on September 16, marking its first rate hike since July 2023. Bitcoin initially dipped following the announcement but quickly recovered above $76,000, suggesting the market largely priced in the move. However, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs experienced significant combined outflows of approximately $746 million between September 15-16. Goldman Sachs projects another rate hike in October, indicating a continued hawkish stance on risk assets.
title: Fed Hikes Rates by 25 Bps; Crypto Market Shows Resilience Amid Outflows

details: Zcash (ZEC) saw an 18% price surge, reaching $1,353.79, after its NU7 governance vote overwhelmingly approved a proposal to reduce block times from 75 seconds to 25 seconds. This development has garnered significant attention, shifting focus towards privacy-focused and higher-beta assets, with social media discussions largely reflecting bullish sentiment on the faster block proposal.
title: Zcash Surges 18% Following NU7 Governance Vote for Faster Blocks

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded substantial combined outflows of approximately $746 million between September 15 and 16, with an additional $295.98 million on September 17. Concurrently, the Senate blocked the CLARITY Act with a 49-50 vote, a bill aimed at providing comprehensive regulatory clarity for digital assets. Analysts suggest this failure shifts regulatory attention to the SEC and CFTC for future crypto rulemaking, particularly concerning stablecoin rewards.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Outflows; Senate Blocks CLARITY Act Amid Regulatory Shifts

details: The Ethereum Institutional Forum is set to relaunch its third edition, scheduled to take place in London on November 12, 2026. This exclusive, invite-only event will bring together key players from traditional finance, including banks and asset managers, alongside Ethereum ecosystem leaders. Discussions will focus on Ethereum's technical roadmap, post-quantum security, native issuance, and its expanding role as an on-chain financial infrastructure.
title: Ethereum Institutional Forum Relaunches in London This November

details: The United States has imposed sanctions on BitBank, an Iranian cryptocurrency exchange, accusing it of processing hundreds of millions of dollars in payments for the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) and facilitating transactions for ships navigating the Strait of Hormuz. The U.S. Treasury Department identified BitBank as a critical component of Iran's digital assets-based sanctions-evasion infrastructure.
title: US Sanctions Iranian Crypto Exchange BitBank Over IRGC Allegations
